roles.B: AI assistant AI 助手（OpenAI Logo）

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We handled success. What should the empty state explain?
dialogue.zh: 成功状态已经处理了，空状态应该说明什么？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It should say that no results were found and offer a next step.
dialogue.zh: 它应该说明没有找到结果，并提供下一步操作。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This panel also needs an error state when the request fails.
dialogue.zh: 请求失败时，这个面板还需要错误状态。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll design both states and keep their actions distinct.
dialogue.zh: 我会设计这两种状态，并让它们的操作清楚区分。

communication_goal: 补齐异常状态，并为用户提供明确的下一步。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at the left and points toward one large upright rectangular interface panel at center. The panel is a complete white outline with a blank black interior divided into two empty unlabeled horizontal areas by one plain line. No words, icons, warning symbols or buttons. The floating white OpenAI knot is at the right. Keep the panel unobstructed and do not add another screen.

coverage_review.scope: V024 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V024.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：单幅黑底白线插画，一个成年火柴人和一个 OpenAI 标识。中央双区域空白面板边界完整且无遮挡，不含任何可读错误或空状态文案；状态含义由对白说明。
